description: This PHP class defines validation rules for ensuring the uniqueness of a property within an entity, with options for trimming input data, ignoring certain values, and matching specific values. It is part of a validation framework in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EntityUniquePropertyOption
classes.description: A class to configure validation rules for unique property constraints within an entity, including options for trimming, ignoring specific values, and matching values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the trimming function and ignore values.

methods.name: setTrim
methods.description: Sets the trimming enabled or disabled.

methods.name: getTrimFunction
methods.description: Returns the closure used for trimming.

methods.name: hasIgnoreValues
methods.description: Checks if ignore values are set.

methods.name: setIgnoreId
methods.description: Helper to set an ID to ignore during validation.

methods.name: hasMatchValues
methods.description: Checks if match values are set.
